args.command:
prev="/opt/nothingness/media/01-undercover-49.opus"; export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG:-nothingness_linux_debug}"; export DRIVE_TARGET=linux; export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}.log"; export DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME="/tmp/nothingness_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"; for i in $(seq 1 30); do out=$( .agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py call ext.nothingness.getPlaybackState 2>/dev/null ); path=$(python - <<'PY'
import json,sys,re
s=sys.stdin.read()
try:
 d=json.loads(s)
except Exception as e:
 print('')
 sys.exit(0)
print(d.get('songInfo',{}).get('path','') or '')
PY
<<<"$out"); if [ "$path" != "$prev" ] && [ -n "$path" ]; then echo "changed_to=$path"; echo "$out"; exit 0; fi; sleep 0.2; done; echo "no change"; exit 1
